name: reader.markdown
doc: Reads the ATX headings of a CommonMark text, the lines of one to six `#` and whitespace, outside code fenced by three backticks: each an element `heading` with its `level` (the number of `#`), its `title` (the rest of the line without the closing `#` and the whitespace around them) and its `line`, from 1, in the order of the text. Setext headings and fences of tildes are not read. The text is the editor's: an editor writes it, never the reading, so no edit is planned. Its fixtures are recorded from the Markdown editor's outline with the Markdown editor's cases (spec 035, T069).
